briefing.headline: BULL plunges 17.8% as risk-off sentiment spreads, while AAPL climbs 0.6%
briefing.summary: Most mega‑cap tech and broad‑market ETFs slipped overnight, with nine of the core ten tickers posting declines and only AAPL posting a modest gain. The move was led by a sharp sell‑off in the leveraged BULL token and heavy losses in other non‑core names such as APMD and MIAX. Defensive plays were scarce, though STDN managed an 8.3% rise, highlighting limited upside in a broadly bearish backdrop. Overall breadth was narrow, indicating a coordinated downside across the tech and index space.
